title: RE-EVALUATING OPEN-ENDED EVALUATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating an evolutionary model and prompt selection process to track skill entropy degradation, and injecting exact and near-redundant adversarial prompts into the evaluation set to measure the vulnerability and rank shifts of Elo rating systems.

Analyzing the marginal rating contributions of co-player actions to observe if the LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., Gemini 1.5 Pro) disproportionately favors or assigns higher ratings to models from its own model family.
